subject: [hw] opus-vdec: VDEC protocol facts + wave3 decode packages (DEC01..DEC08)
body:
Files: gpu/hwcodec/facts/VDEC_PROTOCOL.md, gpu/hwcodec/wave3_decode_packages.json. Host-only.
[V-probe] Current libn2vhost (o2) + phone vpud on T02 fake: AP_IPIMSG_DEC_QUERY_CAP (IPI_VDEC_COMMON) lists outputs incl. NV12/YV12 linear and MM21/MT21, inputs H264/H265/HEIF/VP9/AV1...; H264 16..4096x2176. DEC_INIT on IPI_VDEC_H264 -> INIT_ACK vcu_inst 0x4009ed88 (vsi mapped via n2vcu_map_dm_addr); SET_PARAM FRAME_SIZE/DECODE_MODE status 0. DEC_START (bs pa in vsi.dec.bs_dma, share id via n2shim_ion_register_share in bs_fd) -> status -1, vendor log "get_ringbuf input handle NULL" (libvpud_vcodec get_ringbuf @0x8c70): first decode blocker, DEC01 item 1.
[V-static] H.264 syntax parsing uses the VDEC VLD barrel shifter (H264_HAL_UeCodeNum = read AVC_VLD reg 0x8f; ShiftGetBitStream = vdec_hal_read_vld(n)), so the fake needs a VLD model to parse anything (DEC03) and on the phone every ue/se is a register access.
[V-static] vdec_drv_init_hw_info (libvcodec_utility @0x1e1b8) uses sub-blocks outside the frozen 12 windows: AVC_VLD 0x16022000 (!), PP 0x16024000, 0x16029000, LAT 0x16011800/0x16012000/0x16013000/0x16014800-0x16017fff/0x16018800, SOC 0x16001000/0x16002000/0x16003800/0x1600e000, larb pages 0x1600d000/0x1602e000. Proposal ABI rev 3 RWVC_WIN_VDEC_ALL 0x16000000+0x30000 with per-page domain check (VDE below 0x20000, VDE2 above). Details: VDEC_PROTOCOL.md section 4.
Trap for anyone linking libn2vhost.a: without --whole-archive vpud dies with UNDEF after 21 insns (stub classes win).
